snippet.title: Assassin by day, interior designer by night
snippet.description:
IKEELYA is a short prototype where you play Barry, a disillusioned hitman who has grown tired of his day job, and dreams of becoming an interior decorator.

Download for free on itch.io → https://alldayallnight.itch.io/ikeelya
